description: Set only board tilt to 32 degrees on four shallow far-shot misses; preserve bucket and board position, board height, release gap, exact-action admission, fixed64 physics and v3 scoring. Compare three original and three corrected requests per case, with direct/table-capture/miss controls before and after. This is a post-hoc development correction, not a new policy evaluation.
selection_rule: First two sorted PPO failure contexts per first post-board contact class (table, bucket, robot), original tilt below 22 degrees and horizontal board-to-bucket distance at least 450 mm.
